title: Dancing in the Dark
headline: Springsteen snapped at Jon Landau, then wrote 'Dancing in the Dark'
caption:
Bruce Springsteen's "Dancing in the Dark" came out of him losing his temper with his friend Jon Landau, and then doing what Landau asked anyway.

"You want another one, you write it." According to Dave Marsh's book Glory Days, that's what Springsteen told Landau when Landau said the album needed a single. He pointed out he'd already written seventy songs.

What stays with me is that the song he then wrote in a single night in his hotel room is about feeling isolated after the success of The River, and the frustration of trying to write a hit single.

🎧 The song: "Dancing in the Dark" by Bruce Springsteen (@springsteen)

Source: Dave Marsh, Glory Days (via Wikipedia)

comment: About the song, the band cut six takes at The Hit Factory on February 14, 1984, and it went through 58 mixes before it was finished on March 8.
